id.description: The unique identifier of the invite

tenantId.description: The ID of the tenant this invite belongs to

email.description: The email address of the person being invited

roleId.description: The ID of the role assigned to the invited person

userId.description: The ID of the user being invited, if they already exist

creatorId.description: The ID of the user who created the invite

expiresAt.description: The timestamp when the invite expires

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the invite was created

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the invite was last updated
